status: PILOT — 30 of 221, for review before scaling
note: A SECOND INDEX over the mechanics, never a replacement for them. No record here alters, renames, reorders or reinterprets Rosewater's mechanic, tier or explanation. `key` must always resolve to an existing projection mechanic in mcp2021.reconciled.json; nothing in this file may be written back into the source layer. Families are Vox Mana navigation vocabulary and must be labelled as such wherever they are shown, so a reader never has to guess whether they are looking at Rosewater or at us.

rules.primary_family: exactly one, used for navigation and grouping
rules.secondary_families: zero or more, used for discovery only
rules.never: a family may not become the canonical identity of a mechanic, and may not feed backward into tier, colour or label

families.removal: answering a permanent already on the battlefield
families.card_flow: drawing, filtering, looting, scrying — moving cards through hand and library
families.tutoring: searching the library for a named or typed card
families.mana: producing, fixing, ramping or untapping mana sources
families.graveyard: using the graveyard as a resource, or denying it
families.tokens: creating creatures or artifacts from nothing
families.combat: how creatures fight once they are on the battlefield
families.evasion: making a creature hard or impossible to block
families.protection: keeping your own things alive or untargetable
families.disruption: attacking the opponent's hand, library or resources
families.control: stopping things before or as they happen
families.copying: duplicating a permanent or a spell
families.theft: taking control of something the opponent owns
families.sacrifice: converting your own permanents into another resource
families.life: life total as a resource — gaining, draining, paying
families.tempo: buying or stealing time — bouncing, untapping, extra turns
families.rules_alteration: changing how the game itself works
families.card_type_affinity: caring that a particular card type is present

assignments.key: sacrifice a creature and deal damage to creature/planeswalker/player equal to the sacrificed creature's power/toughness
assignments.note: the multi-family case: it is a sacrifice outlet AND a removal spell, and forcing one label would hide half of what it does
mill both denies the library and fuels a graveyard; which one it is depends entirely on whose library it targets
taking a threat also answers it

assignments.key: time walk (take an extra turn after this one.)

assignments.note: exiles a creature and digs the library for its replacement
